summary: Build an app to sell spray foam products: a simple storefront where customers can browse products and place orders.
imageRequirements:
## Required Images
- Industrial spray foam storefront logo, bold sans-serif wordmark with a simple foam/insulation icon, black/charcoal on light background (spray-foam-logo.dim_512x512.png)
- Wide hero banner featuring a clean industrial/warehouse aesthetic with spray foam/insulation texture motif, neutral grayscale with a warm accent (spray-foam-hero.dim_1600x600.png)
- Product placeholder image with a minimal canister/tank silhouette and foam texture, neutral background (spray-foam-product-placeholder.dim_800x800.png)

existing_features.title: Create a public storefront that lets customers browse spray foam products, view product details, and add items to a cart.
Implement checkout and order placement: collect customer contact and delivery information, show an order summary, and submit the order to the backend.
Add an owner/admin area protected by Internet Identity that allows managing products (create/edit/archive) and viewing incoming orders.

Apply a cohesive visual theme appropriate for an industrial building-materials storefront (no blue/purple palette): strong typography, high-contrast neutral palette, clear pricing/CTA hierarchy, and consistent spacing across pages.
Add generated static brand assets and use them in the UI (hero/banner and a simple logo). Store generated images under frontend/public/assets/generated and reference them directly from the frontend.

new_feature_requests.summary: Create a spray foam sales app storefront with product browsing and customer order placement
Create backend data models and APIs to support: product catalog read access for customers and order creation/storage.

projectName: Spray Foam Storefront: Product Catalog and Order Placement
